attempted_axis: Exact whole-TU flip by restoring retail function/data order in C, retaining the compiler's anonymous zero pool datum, and restoring the retail cross-TU ELF bindings without changing bytes.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.bss-reverse-declaration-order.20260829.v1 SCREENED; MF's atree refinement showed this compiler emits these globals by first-use topology, so the retained source keeps the four storage objects static and in the measured declaration/use topology. claim.law.inline-and-deadstrip-rules.20260829.v1 APPLIED: private inline helpers were placed immediately before their callers so reordering public definitions changed target order without changing bodies. claim.law.symbolified-own-pool-literal-blocks-tu-flip.20260831.v1 APPLIED in refined form: source-owned late definitions preserve the retail bias and dummy-name relocations, while the tool names the compiler's existing anonymous zero object instead of introducing a duplicate literal. claim.law.AF_dtk-rejects-an-unaligned-auto-split-start-so-some-claim-slack-is-structural.20260903.v1 APPLIED: the atree .sdata2 claim ends at aligned 0x80345860 and its final two zero bytes are structural slack. claim.law.webfrank-pinned-function-source-freeze.20260831.v1 APPLIED: DoAnimateTreeFrame, fn_8001267C, AtreeInitSub, and fn_80011BBC bodies were not edited; existing fail-closed pins revalidated in the full build.
attributes.probed_form: Retained source/order form: place AtreeFindNode before AtreeFindNodeIdx and place AtreeInitLists, AtreeListLock, AtreeAlloc, AtreeSetEmpty in target order, with each source-order-sensitive private inline helper immediately before its caller; define sAtreeFrameRoundBias and sAtreeDummyName after their uses; retain sAtreeZero as the compiler-emitted anonymous 0.0f datum. Retained object-interface form: tools/gdl/atree_exports.py parses the big-endian ELF, requires the four defined state objects to be local, discovers exactly one local 4-byte zero .sdata2 object (or a defined sAtreeZero), then uses objcopy only to rename/promote those existing symbols and verifies the output bindings. Refuted pb_diag consumer probe: deriving the four state addresses from whichatree reduced O568 to O566 and worsened real 252 to 338, so it was reverted.
attributes.residual: NONE in atree code, data, order, or linkage. The final two .sdata2 claim bytes are aligned zero-fill slack and advisory, not target data. The exported-symbol restoration is target-independent ELF metadata only and runs in both matching and mod builds. The refutes edge is narrow: MF correctly measured that ordinary global C definitions cannot reproduce retail BSS order; this result refutes only its resulting whole-TU flip veto by decoupling storage layout from binding visibility.
